name: h
description: GitHub-installed Kie generation and AdsPower TikTok publishing workflow with automatic runtime setup.

interface.shortDescription: Kie 生成后直接接入 AdsPower 发布 TikTok。
interface.longDescription: H installs from GitHub and connects Kie generation with AdsPower TikTok publishing through one deterministic Chinese workflow. It supports recursive whole-folder concurrent generation, one-model processing, standalone publishing, and direct publishing of the videos just generated. First use scans and prepares Python, Node, Playwright, and XLSX support for Windows x64, Intel Mac, and Apple Silicon Mac. Publishing always checks and previews before the explicit FABU confirmation, uses exact numeric product PID matching, keeps one profile serial while running different profiles concurrently, and records per-account logs and screenshots.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 批量处理整个 PID 产品文件夹。
使用 H 单独调用一个 Kie 文本、图像或视频模型。
使用 H 将刚生成的视频通过 AdsPower 预览并发布到 TikTok。
使用 H 从 XLSX/CSV 计划表独立批量排期 TikTok 视频。
